newsitem.title: GERMANY: Toepfer sees higher 1997 German grain crop.
newsitem.headline: Toepfer sees higher 1997 German grain crop.

text.p: German grain trader Toepfer in a newsletter said it still saw the 1997 German grain crop exceeding the 1996 result of 42.1 million tonnes.
Repeating a March 24 forecast, it said the crops had lost an early head start from beneficial weather last month after cold weather in April.
But under normal weather patterns, they would still be higher than last year because of an area expansion by five percent.
It noted some winter damage to the barley and rapeseed crops, but added this was regional and limited.
Current temperatures were too cold for the time of year but grain and winter rapeseed crops were still in good shape, Toepfer said.
